posts.summary:
The Internal Revenue Service awarded Accenture Federal Services LLC a blanket purchase agreement call valued at $682,261, with a ceiling of $9.69 million, for computer systems design services. The award supports the Customer Account Data Engine 2 initiative, providing database support for data and platform engineering activities. The agreement was signed on November 19, 2026, and runs through November 20, 2028.

The award was made through full and open competition. Work under this call involves information technology and telecommunications support services focused on business application and application development.

posts.summary:
The Bureau of Indian Affairs awarded a task order to Chickasaw Service Solutions, LLC for cybersecurity and risk management framework services supporting the Office of Information Technology. The task order, signed on November 17, 2026, carries an obligation of $782,586.50 with a ceiling value of $8,248,780.28 and runs from January 1, 2027 through June 30, 2027. The award was set aside for Indian small business economic enterprises and resulted from full and open competition.

The work involves information technology management support and related computer services. Chickasaw Service Solutions was selected under an existing indefinite delivery, indefinite quantity contract vehicle to provide these specialized technical services to the Department of the Interior.

The Department of the Treasury's Departmental Offices awarded Accenture Federal Services LLC a blanket purchase agreement call valued at approximately $8.2 million. The award, signed on November 5, 2026, supports computer systems design services, specifically application development and business software solutions. The work runs through November 4, 2028.

This award was made through full and open competition and covers initial operating capabilities implementation and migration services. The effort falls under the ONEFM blanket purchase agreement framework.
